description: This file defines an Android Activity, 'PresentationWithMediaRouterActivity', that demonstrates how to use the MediaRouter API to detect secondary displays and show content on a presentation display when available. It manages a presentation on external displays, toggling between local and remote display content, and includes inner classes for presentation management.

classes.name: PresentationWithMediaRouterActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing media route detection and presentation on secondary displays, including inner class for custom Presentation.

classes.name: DemoPresentation
classes.description: Inner class extending Presentation, used to display content on an external secondary display, with a GLSurfaceView for rendering graphics.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets content view, and prepares media router and UI components.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers media router callback and updates presentation according to current route.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters media router callback and pauses rendering.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Dismisses active presentation when activity is no longer visible.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu and sets up media routing menu item.

methods.name: updatePresentation
methods.description: Updates or dismisses presentation based on current media route display.

methods.name: updateContents
methods.description: Updates activity UI based on whether the presentation is active or not.
